title: The City counted $8 million of one park’s fees toward another project

beats.text: San Francisco counted $8 million set aside for one park toward a different project.

visual.sub: A second project counted the park’s impact fees as temporary financing

beats.text: The money for Rachele Sullivan Park would help finance Gene Friend Recreation Center.

beats.text: The City had approved $9,725,000 to buy the park site.
